title: Coupon Code Validator
summary: Given arrays for n coupons, each with a code, businessLine, and isActive status, return an array of valid coupon codes sorted by businessLine category and then lexicographically within each category.
statement: Given arrays for n coupons, each with a code, businessLine, and isActive status, return an array of valid coupon codes sorted by businessLine category and then lexicographically within each category. Valid coupons must have a non-empty alphanumeric code, a specific business category, and be active.
constraints: A valid coupon is active, has a nonempty code containing only letters, digits, or underscore, and belongs to an allowed business line.
Business-line order is electronics, grocery, pharmacy, restaurant.
Return valid codes sorted by that category order then lexicographically.
hints: Attach each accepted code to its business-line rank.
Sort tuples by rank then code.
Discard ranks from the ordered result.
editorial: Discard ranks from the ordered result.

tests.explanation: The empty and @ codes are invalid; pharmacy precedes restaurant.
Only active electronics code A_1 remains.
